title: SPSC: Zero-Shot Cross-Subject EEG-to-Image Reconstruction via Semantic Preservation and Subspace Calibration
title_zh: SPSC：基于语义保持与子空间校准的零样本跨被试脑电到图像重建

paragraphs.en: SPSC通过语义保持与子空间校准，实现无标签零样本跨被试脑电图像重建的显著提升。 Pretrained vision-language models and diffusion generators have driven rapid progress in brain-to-image generation, while EEG-based reconstruction is still constrained by low signal-to-noise ratio and cross-subject semantic shifts. Zero-shot cross-subject reconstruction poses even greater challenges: EEG semantic embeddings learned from source subjects deviate from the manifold of image embeddings of the unseen target subject, particularly when neither target labels nor target image embeddings are available. To address this issue, we introduce the Semantic Preservation and Subspace Calibration (SPSC) framework, which first uses Object Mask Contrastive Regularization (OMCR) with object identity for backend training, and then constructs Subspace Candidate Gate (SCG) to achieve label-free semantic correction for target subjects during inference. Specifically, OMCR regularizes the conditioning space with object-level positive samples to preserve object-level feature neighborhoods within the reconstruction prior and low-level branch, while SCG exploits training image prototypes and batch statistics of unlabeled target EEG to select candidates for each task within subspaces of image prototypes. Under the leave-one-subject-out (LOSO) setting across ten subjects on the THINGS-EEG dataset, SPSC improves the cross-subject reconstruction from 0.552 to 0.713 on CLIP and from 0.612 to 0.745 on Alex.5. These significant gains indicate that the semantically calibrated conditions can better support generation for the target subjects under label-free inference.
paragraphs.zh: SPSC通过语义保持与子空间校准，实现无标签零样本跨被试脑电图像重建的显著提升。预训练视觉-语言模型与扩散生成器推动了脑信号到图像生成的快速发展，而基于脑电（EEG）的重建仍受低信噪比和跨被试语义偏移的制约。 零样本跨被试重建面临更大挑战：从源被试学到的脑电语义嵌入会偏离未见过的目标被试的图像嵌入流形，尤其在既无目标标签也无目标图像嵌入可用时更为突出。 为解决这一问题，我们提出语义保持与子空间校准（SPSC）框架，该框架首先使用结合物体身份的物体掩码对比正则化（OMCR）进行后端训练，然后构建子空间候选门（SCG），在推理阶段实现对目标被试的无标签语义校正。 具体而言，OMCR利用物体级正样本对条件空间进行正则化，以在重建先验和低层分支中保持物体级特征邻域；SCG则利用训练图像原型和无标签目标脑电的批统计量，在图像原型的子空间内为每个任务选取候选。 在THINGS-EEG数据集上十名被试的留一被试（LOSO）设置下，SPSC将跨被试重建的CLIP指标从0.552提升至0.713，Alex.5指标从0.612提升至0.745。 这些显著提升表明，经过语义校准的条件能够在无标签推理下更好地支持目标被试的图像生成。
